刚发送过，请稍后再试: Code just sent. Please try again later

吊销「{name}」后，使用它的客户端会立即掉线。: Revoking "{name}" immediately disconnects clients using it.
吊销「{name}」后，使用它的客户端会立即掉线，包括当前浏览器会话。: Revoking "{name}" immediately disconnects clients using it, including this browser session.
复制失败，请手动选择复制: Copy failed. Please select and copy it manually
它只显示这一次，请立即复制保存：: It is shown only this once. Copy and save it now:
客户端按自己测得的延迟自动选择；「延迟」是协调器到该中继的往返时间，每 30 秒: Clients choose by the latency they measure themselves. "Latency" is the coordinator's round trip to the relay, updated every 30 seconds. "Reachable" means the coordinator holds a reservation on that relay.
尝试次数过多，请几分钟后再试: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes
正数入账、负数出账，单位 credit: Positive is income, negative is spending, in credit
用于 sharetoken 客户端和脚本；浏览器会话也在这里: For the sharetoken client and scripts. Browser sessions are listed here too
用法：sharetoken 客户端 config.json 的 token 字段: Usage: the token field of the sharetoken client's config.json, or the HTTP header Authorization: Bearer …
管理功能需要重新登录并完成两步验证: Admin features require logging in again with two-factor authentication
管理员必须启用两步验证。用 Google Authenticator、Micro: Admins must enable two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or similar, or enter the secret key manually, then enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish.
绑定到此账户的 peer；它们花你的 credit、把收入记到你名下: Peers bound to this account. They spend your credit and earn in your name
绑定新设备需要设备私钥签名，所以要在那台机器上运行 {command}。解绑后协: Binding a new device requires a signature from its private key, so run {command} on that machine. After unbinding, the coordinator rejects the device immediately.
解绑「{name}」后它不能再用你的账户买卖；重新绑定需在该设备上再次登录。: After unbinding "{name}", it can no longer buy or sell with your account. To bind it again, log in on that device.
设置已超时，请重新登录: Setup timed out. Please log in again
请填写邮箱收到的验证码: Enter the code sent to your email
请求太频繁，请稍后再试: Too many requests. Please try again later
还没有绑定设备。在你的机器上运行 {command} 即可把该设备绑定到此账户。: No devices bound yet. Run {command} on your machine to bind it to this account.
邮箱地址格式不正确: That email address is not valid
验证已超时，请重新登录: Verification timed out. Please log in again
验证码已发送，请查收邮件（也看看垃圾邮件）: Code sent. Check your email (and the spam folder)
验证码错误或已过期: The code is incorrect or expired
提交太频繁，请稍后再试: Sending too often. Please try again later
管理员发给你的邀请码: The invite code an admin gave you
这个邮箱不能在此注册: This email address cannot sign up here
邀请码错误、已用完或已过期: The invite code is wrong, used up or expired
尝试次数太多，请几分钟后再试: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes
撤销配对码 {code}？它不能再用来配对，已经配对的买家不受影响。: Revoke pairing code {code}? It can no longer be used to pair. Buyers already paired are not affected.
还没有配对卖家，可以向网络上所有卖家购买: Not paired with any seller: this account can buy from every seller on the network
这是你自己的配对码，请把它发给要配对的买家: This is your own pairing code. Give it to the buyers you want to pair with
已达到数量上限，请先解除或撤销一些: The limit is reached. Unpair or revoke some first
解除和卖家 {name} 的配对？之后这个账户不再向他购买，除非重新配对。: Unpair from seller {name}? This account will no longer buy from them unless it pairs again.
移除买家 {name}？如果这是他唯一配对的卖家，他会恢复为向整个网络购买。: Remove buyer {name}? If you are the only seller they are paired with, they go back to buying from the whole network.
备注（配对的买家也会看到，可不填）: Note (paired buyers see it too; optional)
可配对的买家数: Number of buyers it can pair
只为和你配对的买家服务。开启后，其他买家看不到你的模型，也不能向你购买。: Serve only the buyers paired with you. While it is on, other buyers do not see your models and cannot buy from you.
生成配对码发给你的买家: Create pairing codes and give them to your buyers
把它发给要配对的买家。拿到它的人都能和你配对，请只发给你信任的人。: Give it to the buyers you want to pair with. Anyone who has it can pair with you, so share it only with people you trust.
这个账户现在只向下面的卖家购买。全部解除后，恢复为向整个网络购买。: This account now buys only from the sellers below. Unpair from all of them to buy from the whole network again.
配对码不对，或者已经过期、被撤销或用完: This pairing code is wrong, or it has expired, been revoked or been used up
卖家发出配对码，买家兑换后只向和它配对的卖家购买: A seller hands out a pairing code; a buyer that redeems it buys only from the sellers it is paired with
还没有买家和你配对: No buyers are paired with you yet
登录不需要密码：每次用发到这个邮箱的验证码登录。: No password needed: you sign in each time with a code sent to this email address.
设置已超时，请重新开始: Setup timed out. Please start again
这个邮箱还没有账户，本站目前不开放注册，请联系管理员: This email address has no account, and sign-up is closed here. Please contact an administrator
管理员必须保留两步验证。更换手机时请让其他管理员在控制台重置，或在服务器上执行: Administrators must keep two-factor authentication. If you change phones, ask another administrator to reset it in the console, or run portal mfa-reset on the server.
新账户需要邀请码，请填写后重新发送验证码: A new account needs an invite code. Enter it and send the code again
这个账户开启了两步验证，请输入验证器 App 显示的 6 位验证码。: This account uses two-factor authentication. Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
这个邮箱还没有账户，验证后会自动创建。: This email address has no account yet; one is created when you verify.
本站暂时无法发送邮件，请联系管理员: This site cannot send email right now. Please contact an administrator
用 Google Authenticator、Microsoft Authent: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or similar, or enter the secret by hand, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
这个账户已被停用，请联系客服: This account is disabled. Please contact support
没有账户的邮箱会在验证后自动注册。: An email address without an account is signed up when you verify it.
登录时除了邮箱验证码，还要输入验证器 App 的验证码。关闭时请输入验证器 Ap: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app as well as the email code. To turn it off, enter the code your authenticator app shows now.
管理员必须启用两步验证，下次登录时会要求绑定。: Administrators must use two-factor authentication; you will be asked to set it up at your next sign-in.
告诉我们你遇到的问题或建议。请不要填写验证码、token 或 prompt 内容: Tell us about a problem or idea. Please do not include sign-in codes, tokens or prompt contents. We may reply to your account's email address.
开启后，登录时除了邮箱验证码，还要输入验证器 App（如 Google Auth: Once on, signing in asks for a code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator) as well as the email code, so your account stays safe even if your mailbox is compromised.
